'''Wasskah''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]].

==History==
The moon was colonized by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]].<ref name="EOTECR" />
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was the site of a Trandoshan hunting party that captured sentients from various parts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and brought them onto the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] to use as prey. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was captured by the hunters and brought to Wasskah. Tano attempted to save several other Padawans who had also been captured and stranded there.<ref name="PL" /> The surviving Padawans banded together with the captured [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and managed to contact his friend, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]], who arrived with a rescue team. The Trandoshan gang was wiped out in the [[Battle on Wasskah/Legends|skirmish]].<ref name="WH" />
